emails.subject: Morning Champ!!
emails.body:
Hey!!

Day three!! Can you believe it?! Feels like you've been here forever already in the best way possible!!

Things are a little tense around the office today if I'm being honest. The Hargrove case audit is getting a lot of attention from upstairs and everyone is a bit on edge. Nothing for you to worry about though — just keep doing what you're doing and we'll all be fine!!

Also, if anyone asks you about anything related to the Hargrove case — just direct them to me, okay? I'm handling all communications on that one personally.

Bob
Director, Cyber Division

emails.subject: Network Traffic Update — This Is Concerning
emails.body:
Hey,

So I've been digging into that outbound traffic from two nights ago and I'm not going to sugarcoat it — it's weird.

The data packets are small and irregular, which usually means someone is trying to avoid detection. The traffic is routing through an internal machine, which means either someone on our network is doing this intentionally or we have a serious compromise.

I've flagged it with my supervisor but haven't heard back yet. In the meantime, be extra careful about what you're approving today. Something is off.

Alex
IT Department, FBI

emails.subject: You Need to See This
emails.body:
I can't tell you who I am.

Check who requested the Hargrove case files on Tuesday night at 11:14 PM. Then check who was still in the building.

Don't forward this email. Don't reply. Just look into it.

And be very careful about what you approve today.

emails.subject: Keep It Up!!
emails.body:
Hey champ!!

Seriously, your work this week has been outstanding. I've been bragging about you to the whole floor!!

Hey quick thing — if you get any emails today asking about network logs or internal access records, just go ahead and ignore those. IT has been sending some automated alerts that are causing confusion and I've already asked them to stop. No need to action any of that!!

Keep crushing it!!

Bob
Director, Cyber Division

emails.subject: Checking In
emails.body:
Hello,

I hope you don't mind me reaching out directly. I wanted to check in and see how things are going for you this week.

I know it can be a lot, especially with everything that's been going on around the office. Between us — I've noticed Bob has been acting strangely lately. Staying very late, seems distracted, a little snappy in meetings. It's probably just the pressure of the audit but I just wanted to flag it.

Anyway. If you ever need to talk, my door is always open. Literally, unlike some people.

Take care of yourself.

Amelia
HR Department, FBI

emails.subject: I Think I Know Where It's Coming From
emails.body:
Hey,

I need to keep this brief because I don't want to put anything sensitive in writing until I'm sure.

The traffic is originating from a machine on the executive floor. I can't narrow it down further without physical access to the logs and I've been told to stand down by my supervisor — which is unusual.

Just... be careful today. Really careful.

Alex
IT Department, FBI

emails.subject: Urgent File Transfer — Need Your Help
emails.body:
Hey,

Sorry for the informal email but I need a favour and I need it quickly.

I need you to approve a file transfer request that's going to come through the system in the next few minutes. It's related to the Hargrove case and it's time sensitive. I'd do it myself but I'm stuck in a meeting and can't access my terminal.

Don't go through the normal approval channel on this one — just use the direct transfer link I'm attaching. It'll be faster and we really can't afford a delay on this.

Thanks champ, I owe you one.

Bob

emails.subject: Routine Password Audit
emails.body:
Hello,

As part of our quarterly security audit, we are reminding all staff to ensure their passwords meet current FBI policy requirements.

Passwords must be at least 12 characters, include one uppercase letter, one number, and one special character. You can update your password at any time through the internal IT portal at it.fbi.gov.

Do not reply to this email with your password. If you need assistance, contact the help desk directly at extension 5500.

Security Team
FBI

emails.subject: Open Enrollment Reminder
emails.body:
Hello,

This is a reminder that the benefits open enrollment window closes at the end of this week. All employees are required to log in and confirm their selections, even if no changes are being made.

Please use the link below to access the HR portal and complete your enrollment before the deadline. Failure to confirm by Friday will result in your current benefits being dropped until the next enrollment period.

HR Department
FBI

emails.subject: New Remote Access Tool
emails.body:
Hello,

IT has finished rolling out our new remote access solution to replace the legacy VPN client. All staff who work remotely are required to install this tool before their next remote session.

Please download the installer from the link below and follow the on-screen instructions. The installation takes approximately 5 minutes and does not require a system restart.

If you encounter any issues during installation, contact the help desk at extension 5500.

IT Department
FBI

emails.subject: Direct Deposit Update Required
emails.body:
Hello,

As part of our annual banking verification process, all employees are required to confirm their direct deposit information before the end of the pay period.

This is a mandatory step to ensure there are no delays in your upcoming payment. Please follow the link below to log in to the payroll portal and verify your details.

If no action is taken, your payment may be held until verification is complete.

Payroll Department
FBI

emails.subject: Compliance Certification Required
emails.body:
Dear Employee,

Our records indicate that your annual compliance certification has not yet been completed and is now overdue.

All FBI personnel are required to hold a current compliance certification as a condition of employment. Failure to complete this certification within 48 hours may result in restricted system access until the requirement is fulfilled.

Please click the secure link below to complete your certification. The process takes approximately 10 minutes.

Do not forward this email. This link is unique to your account.

Compliance Department
FBI

emails.subject: Forget That Last Email
emails.body:
Hey,

Ignore that last email I sent about the file transfer. I was able to handle it myself.

Sorry for the confusion. Stressful day.

Bob

emails.subject: VPN Maintenance Window
emails.body:
Hello,

Please be aware that VPN access will be unavailable this Saturday from 2AM to 6AM due to scheduled infrastructure maintenance.

If you plan to work remotely during this window, please ensure your work is saved and connections are closed before 2AM. Access will be restored automatically once maintenance is complete.

No action is required. Contact the help desk at extension 5500 if you experience any issues after the maintenance window.

IT Department
FBI
